**Calculating cavity dimensions**

I'm observing the cavity structure, which includes the central roof and ceiling flats at z.55, along with the walls. Now, the base rim has two wires, and I need to calculate the area: subtracting the cavity opening of 8.96 from the outer area of 12 gives me exactly 3.04. That looks good! It all seems to be lining up just right, which is reassuring.

part.name: Cylindrical Saddle Support Block
part.description: A rectangular support block with a shallow concave cylindrical cradle on its upper side and a recessed, similarly curved underside cavity. Flat end lands terminate the cradle, while outer side and end walls connect the upper geometry to a planar perimeter base rim. No holes, fasteners, or separate joints are present.
part.symmetry_note: The part is bilaterally symmetric about the longitudinal center plane x=0 and about the transverse center plane y=0. The upper and lower cylindrical surfaces are coaxial about an axis parallel to x, but have different radii and widths.

Section.name: Upper cradle interface
Section.function intent: Supports and locates a cylindrical or rounded mating component while spreading contact load over a broad curved surface. The flat lands provide stable terminal regions and clearance beyond the curved seating zone.
Section.physical behavior: The concave cylindrical surface reacts downward contact pressure and limits transverse displacement of a seated cylindrical part. Loads pass through the curved shell into the outer walls and base rim. The two end lands increase local thickness and resist edge damage at the cradle terminations.
Section.geometry: A central concave cylindrical patch of radius 4.215 mm, extending across the full 2.0 mm part width and approximately 4.8 mm along its length, bounded at both longitudinal ends by coplanar rectangular lands at z=0.75 mm.
Section.location: Upper side of the part, centered between y=-3 mm and y=3 mm.

major_faces.name: Negative-y upper end land
major_faces.description: Flat rectangular upper land at z=0.75 mm between y=-3.0 mm and y=-2.4 mm.

major_faces.name: Concave cylindrical cradle
major_faces.description: Primary upward-facing cylindrical seating surface, radius 4.215 mm, with axis parallel to x.

major_faces.name: Positive-y upper end land
major_faces.description: Flat rectangular upper land at z=0.75 mm between y=2.4 mm and y=3.0 mm.

Section.name: Outer structural body
Section.function intent: Forms the external load-bearing body, protects the recessed underside, and transfers forces from the upper cradle toward the base perimeter.
Section.physical behavior: The broad longitudinal walls act as deep webs under cradle loading, resisting bending and maintaining the spacing between the upper interface and base. The transverse end walls close the structure, resist local crushing, and stabilize the side walls against spreading.
Section.geometry: Four planar exterior walls define a 2.0 mm wide by 6.0 mm long envelope. The longitudinal side profiles follow the varying height created by the upper cylindrical valley and flat end lands.
Section.location: Around the full exterior perimeter of the part between the upper cradle and bottom base plane.

major_faces.name: Positive-x exterior side wall
major_faces.description: Planar outer longitudinal wall at x=1.0 mm, with its upper boundary following the saddle profile.

major_faces.name: Positive-y exterior end wall
major_faces.description: Rectangular transverse end face at y=3.0 mm spanning the full width and height.

major_faces.name: Negative-x exterior side wall
major_faces.description: Planar outer longitudinal wall at x=-1.0 mm, symmetric to the positive-x wall.

major_faces.name: Negative-y exterior end wall
major_faces.description: Rectangular transverse end face at y=-3.0 mm spanning the full width and height.

Section.name: Underside relief cavity
Section.function intent: Removes noncritical material beneath the cradle while preserving a curved shell, side webs, closed end regions, and a perimeter mounting rim.
Section.physical behavior: The recessed cavity lowers mass and material usage. Its cylindrical ceiling approximately follows the upper cradle, producing a relatively thin curved shell through the central region. Internal side and end walls brace the shell and transfer its load into the perimeter rim.
Section.geometry: A bottom-open rectangular recess bounded laterally at x=±0.8 mm and longitudinally at y=±2.8 mm. Its central ceiling is cylindrical with radius 4.415 mm and axis parallel to x; short planar ceiling ledges occur at both longitudinal ends.
Section.location: Inside the lower side of the block, inset 0.2 mm from each longitudinal side and 0.2 mm from each end.

major_faces.name: Negative-y cavity ceiling ledge
major_faces.description: Short planar internal ceiling at z=0.55 mm connecting the curved cavity roof to the negative-y inner end wall.

major_faces.name: Negative-y internal end wall
major_faces.description: Planar transverse cavity wall at y=-2.8 mm extending from the base opening to the internal ceiling ledge.

major_faces.name: Positive-x internal side wall
major_faces.description: Planar longitudinal cavity wall at x=0.8 mm with an upper edge following the cavity roof and ledges.

major_faces.name: Positive-y internal end wall
major_faces.description: Planar transverse cavity wall at y=2.8 mm extending from the base opening to the internal ceiling ledge.

major_faces.name: Positive-y cavity ceiling ledge
major_faces.description: Short planar internal ceiling at z=0.55 mm connecting the positive-y inner end wall to the curved cavity roof.

major_faces.name: Cylindrical cavity ceiling
major_faces.description: Central cylindrical underside surface of radius 4.415 mm, offset below and coaxial with the upper cradle.

major_faces.name: Negative-x internal side wall
major_faces.description: Planar longitudinal cavity wall at x=-0.8 mm, symmetric to the positive-x internal wall.

Section.name: Bottom perimeter base rim
Section.function intent: Provides a stable planar footprint around the underside recess for mounting, seating, or transferring load into an adjoining flat structure.
Section.physical behavior: The continuous rim bears against a planar support and carries compressive reaction forces from the outer walls and internal cavity walls. Its closed rectangular loop helps resist distortion around the cavity opening.
Section.geometry: A planar rectangular annular face at z=-0.75 mm. The outer boundary is 2.0 mm by 6.0 mm and the internal rectangular opening is approximately 1.6 mm by 5.6 mm.
Section.location: Lowest side of the part, surrounding the complete underside cavity opening.

major_faces.name: Planar perimeter base rim
major_faces.description: Continuous bottom mounting face at z=-0.75 mm with an inner wire defining the cavity opening.
